title: Create a separate Google Calendar with AI
h1: make a separate google calendar for one project
description: Ask a bot to create a secondary Google Calendar with a clear title, description and time zone. Keep event creation and sharing as separate decisions.
keywords: google calendar create secondary calendar with ai
answer: a bot can create a secondary google calendar for a project, season or separate part of your life. you give it a title and can add a description, location and time zone. the connected google account becomes the owner. specify the time zone explicitly because it defaults to utc. making a calendar is a change, so it won't ask first unless you tell it to.
og_line: give the project its own calendar.
what:
a separate calendar gives a new activity its own place without adding every event to your primary calendar. this action creates that secondary calendar and its descriptive settings. it does not populate a rehearsal schedule merely because the calendar is called rehearsals.

the title is required. choose the account that should own it, and tell it your time zone, for example "paris time"; otherwise google sets the calendar to utc. adding events or arranging access for collaborators requires other work.
uses: give a touring production a calendar separate from your personal appointments
create a fresh calendar for the next course intake with its location in the description
set up a temporary calendar for an office move before anyone starts adding appointments

routine.message: on the first tuesday of each quarter at 11, ask whether the next harrow lane theatre season needs a new google calendar. show me the proposed season title, description, location and paris time zone here before creating it in my work account. create it only after i confirm, then return its details in this chat. never add events or change sharing.
routine.when: first tuesday of each quarter at 11:00
routine.needs: google calendar connected, read and write access for creating calendars
routine.output:
ready to create: harrow lane winter rehearsals
owner: your connected work account
location: west rehearsal room
time zone: paris time
awaiting your confirmation; no calendar created yet.

steps: select the intended google account in **Connected apps** and give the setup bot **read and write** access for calendar creation.
send the exact title and purpose, including the time zone rather than leaving it to the default.
require a confirmation in your message if you want the proposed calendar checked before creation.
inspect the new calendar details once it is created. use **Pause** if the quarterly setup prompt is no longer useful.
watch: omitting the time zone creates a calendar in utc. a location description does not set the time zone for you.
ownership belongs to the authenticated account. selecting personal gmail by mistake can put a work calendar under the wrong owner.
creating a calendar is not creating its events, and this action has no sharing input. describe those as separate tasks if you need them.

faq.q: does this replace my primary google calendar?
faq.a: no. it creates a new secondary calendar owned by the connected account.

faq.q: can i name the calendar and set its city?
faq.a: yes. the title is required, while location and description are optional. also specify the time zone, since the city text does not replace that setting.
